summary: This directory contains unit tests for core infrastructure utilities and helper functions that support the broader application logic. It ensures the reliability and correctness of fundamental utility methods through automated verification.
responsibilities: Verify the correctness of core helper utilities
Ensure runtime assertion and debugging tools function as expected
Provide a testing suite for low-level application infrastructure
relationships: The testing suite verifies the behavior of assertion utilities to prevent runtime errors.
Caller identification functions are validated to ensure reliable debugging and execution tracing.
designDecisions: Colocation of test files with their corresponding core implementation modules
Utilization of automated unit testing frameworks to enforce code quality
